role: Codable model for structured interval workouts: IntervalStep (timed or distance step with a target and label) and IntervalPlan (ordered steps + whole-plan repeatCount), plus the three built-in preset plans shown in WorkoutPreflightView — the only plans that exist.
types: IntervalStep: struct (Codable, Equatable, Identifiable) — one step; id = index
IntervalStep.Target: enum — zone / hrRange / paceSecPerKm / effort
IntervalPlan: struct (Codable, Equatable, Identifiable) — named step list with repeatCount and presets
state: mem:IntervalPlan.presets (static let: 'Easy base (30 min Z2)' id 1111…, "5×3' tempo @ Z4" id 2222…, '4×30/30 VO₂ (2 sets)' id 3333…)
toplevel: IntervalPlan.presets is a static let evaluated lazily on first access (WorkoutPreflightView.swift:785); it builds three plans with fixed UUID literals via presetID and the 30/30 plan via thirtyThirtySteps(sets: 2). All Codable/Equatable conformances are synthesized.

units.does: Identifiable id = step index (stable only within one plan).
units.entry: Identifiable conformance requirement only; no SwiftUI ForEach or other identity use of IntervalStep exists in the repo (ForEach is only over IntervalPlan.presets at WorkoutPreflightView.swift:785).

units.does: Maps the stored English label to its localized string for the 8 preset labels via LanguageManager.appBundle; any other label is returned unchanged. Used by FitnessRecordingView.swift:433 for the live step row.

English AI-facing phrase: label, then amount (duration or distance, omitted when neither), then target, joined by ' — ' (e.g. 'warm up — 5 min — @ Zone 2'). Read by WorkoutRecorder+Context.liveIntervalProgressSnapshot for workout.live.interval.* facts.
Duration text when durationSec is set ('N min', 'N min S s', or 'S s'), else distance text ('X.X km' at >=1000 m, else 'N m'), else [] for an open-ended step.

branches.effect: true: formats time (distance ignored even if also set); false: falls to distance
true: ['N min S s']; false: ['S s']

units.does: Formats the target: '@ Zone z', '@ lo–hi bpm', '@ m:ss/km', or '@ <effort rawValue> effort'.
Localized plan name for the three preset names; any other name returned as stored. Used by WorkoutPreflightView.swift:786 preset chips.
Builds a UUID from a literal; traps with preconditionFailure naming the literal if malformed.

branches.effect: preconditionFailure (crash at first presets access); all three literals are valid so this never fires

units.does: Builds the flat 30/30 step list: a 10-min Z2 warm-up then `sets` copies of [30s hard Z5, 30s easy Z2 ×3 alternations, 30s hard, 3-min rest Z1], with sequential indices.

branches.cond: label missing from the zones dictionary
branches.effect: falls back to zone 2; unreachable because every spec label ('warm up','hard','easy','rest') is a key
